notes: The Vonage (Nexmo) SMS API, OpenAPI 3.0 v1.2.0. The SMS API is a single endpoint — POST {https://rest.nexmo.com/sms}/{format} — with 9 component schemas covering the request, the per-message response and every error shape; that one operation IS the whole API, and it is what the adaptor's only operation (sendSMS) calls. PROVENANCE, per the vendor-published-only rule: this spec is Vonage's own, but Vonage no longer hosts it — the repo apis.guru records as its origin (nexmo/api-specification definitions/sms.yml) 404s, as does the renamed Vonage org path, and developer.vonage.com redirects to a docs app. upstream.json is therefore apis.guru's preserved copy, which makes this converted rather than found-openapi. Vonage publishes separate specs for its other products (voice, verify, messages, number insight); those are different APIs, and the nexmo adaptor exports no generic request builders that could reach them. Replaces a 4 KiB hand-authored spec.
